purpose: Acceptance specification, not execution evidence. Actual outcomes belong in device-results.json.

policy.reason: Debug APK authorized for manual user testing on 2026-11-06; Android execution is not acceptance evidence until recorded.

fixturePolicy.profile: Separate test-only Android app/profile and synthetic fixtures

scenarios.scenario: Clean start and Room v1/v2/v3 to current v4 upgrade
scenarios.expected: Synthetic library, playlists, history and settings survive; restored queue is paused.

scenarios.scenario: SAF/MediaStore allow/deny, restart, moved file and relink
scenarios.expected: Denial is explained; retained grant works; scanning never deletes collection entries.

scenarios.scenario: Local and available progressive/VOD HLS play/pause/seek/next/previous
scenarios.expected: Actual audible sound and correct transport; bounded retry; pause during preparation stays paused.

scenarios.scenario: Queue duplicates, reorder, delete current/last, clear and restore
scenarios.expected: Correct occurrence plays; shuffle/repeat order is retained; restart restores paused.

scenarios.scenario: Crossfade 0/1/6/12 seconds with short tracks, seek, pause and error
scenarios.expected: Real two-deck transition; user actions or failures cancel safely; no unrequested resume.

scenarios.scenario: Call/other audio, transient/permanent focus, wired/BT disconnect
scenarios.expected: One focus owner; correct duck/pause; late gain never overrides a user pause.

scenarios.scenario: EQ/bass/spatial support, absent support and session replacement
scenarios.expected: Settings persist atomically; unsupported effects are identified; no leaked effects or clipping.

scenarios.scenario: Rotation, background, lock screen, Activity and process death
scenarios.expected: Stable media owner/controller reconnect; paused checkpoint recovery; no spontaneous audio.

scenarios.scenario: Flow with empty/small library, offline, autoplay and unavailable source
scenarios.expected: No retry loop; only eligible tracks are appended; empty state offers useful actions.

scenarios.scenario: Smart rules and favorite/download/history mutations
scenarios.expected: Matching collection updates reactively; malformed rules can be repaired.

scenarios.scenario: All download states, network loss, restart, low storage, airplane mode
scenarios.expected: Partial cache is never complete offline media; completed packages play without network; remove preserves library.

scenarios.scenario: JSON/desktop import cancel, merge, repeat, conflict and damaged input
scenarios.expected: Original fixture copy is byte-identical; atomic/idempotent merge; no history duplication.

scenarios.scenario: Spotify PKCE login/cancel/restart callback/refresh/logout
scenarios.expected: Valid one-time state; real access status; metadata and full audio availability distinguished.

scenarios.scenario: Yandex login/revocation/account rights and audio resolution
scenarios.expected: Capability matches account rights; tokens are absent from logs and foreign requests.

scenarios.scenario: Keystore corruption/relogin and account change during requests
scenarios.expected: Old account data and signed URLs cannot reappear under the new account; secrets stay out of backups.

scenarios.scenario: Fast query/source change, IME, history and partial source failure
scenarios.expected: Obsolete response never replaces the new query; successful partial results remain available.

scenarios.scenario: Synced/plain/instrumental/missing/error lyrics, scroll and track change
scenarios.expected: Text belongs to current track; manual reading and return work; retry bypasses negative cache.

scenarios.scenario: Listening history with seek/pause/replay/crossfade/day boundary
scenarios.expected: Only measured listening time counts; no seek inflation or double counting.

scenarios.scenario: 320/360/412dp, wide/split window, landscape, font 200%, TalkBack/RTL
scenarios.expected: All primary actions, focus and text remain accessible; insets and back behavior are correct.

scenarios.scenario: Light/dark/system, accents, glass/power saver and first frame
scenarios.expected: Consistent initial theme, opaque fallback and reduced motion; playback service is retained.

scenarios.scenario: Shared tokens, prototype geometry and native screenshot regression
scenarios.expected: Exact color tokens; key dimensions within 2dp; same fixtures/font/theme; intentional deviations recorded.

scenarios.scenario: Long library and rapid commands during loading
scenarios.expected: Responsive UI; no stale commands, unbounded retry or main-thread network/disk operation.
